mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment ( board_id, member_id, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.board_id, c.member_id, m.nickname, c.content, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM comment c JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.created_at
